expertiseSources.summary: Records the immutable upstream commit, repeated test-hardening lessons, portability changes, overlap boundaries, and security review for the migrated verification workflow.

exception.rationale: The workflow prevents false-green tests, weakened assertions, unbounded CPU checks, and unnoticed build churn. These validation-integrity controls reduce release risk directly and are better evaluated through adversarial test review than average output-quality uplift at experimental entry.
